title: Experimental data of manuscript "Stretchable Light-Emitting Electrochemical Cells Fabricated by Spray-Coating", Gellner et al.
measurement_dates: Device-file dates where provided; whole-campaign acquisition dates unknown.
author_preprocessing: Measured current/luminance traces, microscopy TIFFs and Origin project files. Preserve original Figshare folder hierarchy because filenames recur.
known_analyses_and_limitations: At least 17 identified devices with uneven loading-group counts. Hold out devices and full strain sweeps; images and fitted project outputs are supporting context.
independent_groups: device and polymer-loading group; complete strain sweeps
